title: Account Access and Login Issues
content:
Employees who cannot access their company accounts
        should first verify their login credentials.
        If the account is locked or access is denied,
        the ticket must be sent to the Identity and Access
        Management team. Never request a user's password.

title: Data Loss and File Recovery
content:
Accidental deletion of important company files
        must be escalated to the IT Data Recovery team.
        Employees should avoid modifying affected files
        or storage locations until IT has assessed the issue.

title: Company-Wide System Outages
content:
A company-wide outage preventing employees from
        working is classified as critical and must be
        escalated immediately to the IT Incident Response team.

title: Password Reset Requests
content:
Standard password reset requests should use the
        approved self-service password reset portal.
        If self-service fails, the ticket must be reviewed
        by the IT Helpdesk.

title: Suspicious Emails and Phishing
content:
Employees who receive suspicious emails should
        report them to the Security Operations team.
        If a suspicious link was opened or credentials
        were entered, the incident requires urgent review.
